// This inert Server fixture runs only inside a pinned vendored Mimir module.
package redis_rates_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/prometheus/prometheus/promql"
	"github.com/prometheus/prometheus/promql/promqltest"
)

// Native evaluation, including source timestamps, vector matching and resets.
// Real vectors are returned to the owning Server reducer after the independent
// exact-vector assertions have passed.
func TestRedisRatesConfiguredCohort(t *testing.T) {
	path := os.Getenv("MONITOR_PROMQL_TEST_SCRIPT")
	responsePath := os.Getenv("MONITOR_PROMQL_TEST_RESPONSES")
	if path == "" || responsePath == "" {
		t.Fatal("MONITOR_PROMQL_TEST_SCRIPT and MONITOR_PROMQL_TEST_RESPONSES are required")
	}
	script, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	engine := promqltest.NewTestEngine(t, false, 5*time.Minute, 1_000_000)
	promqltest.RunTest(t, string(script), engine)
	responses := map[string]json.RawMessage{}
	for _, block := range strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(string(script), "# "), "\n# ") {
		name, body, ok := strings.Cut(block, "\nclear\n")
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("invalid native fixture block")
		}
		load, evaluations, ok := strings.Cut(body, "\neval instant at ")
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("native fixture omitted evaluation")
		}
		statement, _, _ := strings.Cut(evaluations, "\n")
		clock, expression, ok := strings.Cut(statement, " ")
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("native fixture omitted query")
		}
		evaluation, err := time.ParseDuration(clock)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		func() {
			storage := promqltest.LoadedStorage(t, load+"\n")
			defer storage.Close()
			query, err := engine.NewInstantQuery(context.Background(), storage,
				promql.NewPrometheusQueryOpts(false, 5*time.Minute), expression,
				time.Unix(0, 0).UTC().Add(evaluation))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			defer query.Close()
			result := query.Exec(context.Background())
			vector, err := result.Vector()
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if len(result.Warnings) != 0 {
				t.Fatal("native synthetic query returned unexpected warnings")
			}
			rows := []map[string]any{}
			for _, sample := range vector {
				if sample.H != nil {
					t.Fatal("native synthetic query returned a histogram")
				}
				rows = append(rows, map[string]any{
					"metric": sample.Metric.Map(),
					"value": []any{float64(sample.T) / 1000, strconv.FormatFloat(sample.F, 'g', -1, 64)},
				})
			}
			response, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
				"status": "success",
				"data": map[string]any{"resultType": "vector", "result": rows},
			})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if _, duplicate := responses[name]; duplicate {
				t.Fatal("duplicate native fixture case")
			}
			responses[name] = response
		}()
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(responses)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(responsePath, encoded, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
